 Grand Theft Auto 6 interactive map - Shackmaps
 Our GTA 6 map has everything you need to 100% the game, from all story missions and activities, to all collectible cards, animals, stunts, and much more.
 Sam Chandler 
 November 20, 2026 8:40 PM 
 1 
 Our GTA 6 map will be your best place to track everything the game has to offer. This interactive map for Grand Theft Auto 6, though currently a work-in-progress, will contain every single story mission, collectible card, stunt, activity, and much more. Create a free Shackmaps account to track your progress.
 Grand Theft Auto 6 interactive map
 The GTA 6 map on Shackmaps is a hand-crafted resources for you to use, completely for free, to track your progress through the game. All you need to do is create an account and start using the map. This is a work-in-progress, so expect to see pins added every hour of every day until it is completed. The following image is just a zoomed-in version of the larger map to preserve some element of surprise for those still working through the start of the game!
 Click the image to go directly to the GTA 6 map.
Source: Shackmaps 
 As mentioned above, expect to find the main story missions and side objectives, the various stunt locations, treasure diving spots, collectibles (like the many collectible cards), drone time trials, rare vehicle locations, hunting places, and everything else on offer in Grand Theft Auto 6.
 There are many other interactive maps on Shackmaps for you to use. Create a free account to track your progress across them all. Stay tuned to our GTA 6 Strategy Guide for more help with Rockstar Games’ phenomenal title.
